column1: # title|topic|audience|announcement|reason|requested action|condition|follow-up|inference

Reusable delivery crates|採購物流|warehouse staff|Reusable crates will replace cardboard cartons for local deliveries.|The trial showed that the crates protect fragile products more effectively.|Record the number of empty crates returned by each driver.|Crates containing chemical products must be stored separately from food containers.|The logistics team will review the return records before ordering more crates.|The company wants to reduce damage without mixing incompatible goods.

Quiet work area|辦公協作|office employees|A former storage room is becoming a quiet workspace for individual tasks.|Staff said they could not concentrate near the shared telephone desks.|Reserve a desk through the internal booking page.|Calls and group discussions must take place outside the room.|The facilities team will evaluate demand after the first month.|The new space is intended for focused work rather than meetings.

Accessible museum tours|文化休閒|museum visitors|The museum is introducing tours that use a route without stairs.|Several visitors requested a tour suitable for people using wheelchairs.|Tell the booking office about any access requirements.|Advance booking is required even for visitors who already hold annual passes.|A guide will contact each group to confirm its arrival point.|An annual pass does not remove the need to book the accessible tour.

Repair before replacement|科技維修|computer users|Employees can now request a repair assessment before replacing a laptop.|Many discarded machines needed only inexpensive battery replacements.|Describe the fault in a support request.|Employees must keep company data on the approved network during the repair.|The support team will issue a temporary machine when necessary.|Some older computers may remain useful after minor repairs.

Farm collection point|餐飲零售|farm customers|Vegetable orders can be collected from a refrigerated locker near the market.|Customers working late often miss the staffed collection hours.|Enter the code from the order confirmation at the locker.|Orders must be collected within one day because locker space is limited.|Uncollected produce will be donated to the community kitchen.|The locker extends access but does not allow indefinite storage.

Volunteer translation|社區服務|community volunteers|The welcome center is seeking volunteers to translate its visitor guide.|More residents now speak languages that the existing guide does not cover.|Send a short sample translation to the coordinator.|Volunteers must agree to a review by another speaker of the language.|The center will publish the revised guides after all reviews are complete.|A translation will be checked before it is distributed.

Shared instrument booking|製造品質|laboratory technicians|A shared calendar will be used for the precision measuring instruments.|Two departments recently reserved the same device for overlapping inspections.|Enter the expected start and finish times for each inspection.|Urgent safety inspections may take priority over routine reservations.|The quality manager will resolve any scheduling conflicts.|A confirmed routine booking can still be displaced by urgent work.

Rainwater garden|環境設施|building tenants|The courtyard will be converted into a garden that absorbs rainwater.|Heavy storms have repeatedly flooded the basement entrance.|Use the covered passage while the courtyard is closed.|Emergency access to the building will remain open throughout construction.|The landscape contractor will post weekly progress photographs.|The project is intended to address drainage rather than add parking.

Returnable uniforms|職場人事|seasonal employees|Seasonal uniforms will now be issued on a returnable basis.|The company wants to reuse clothing that is still in good condition.|Return all issued garments at the end of the contract.|Normal wear is acceptable, but employees should report torn garments immediately.|The laundry service will inspect and clean returned uniforms.|Employees are not expected to return uniforms in unused condition.

Audio description service|文化休閒|theater guests|Selected performances will offer spoken descriptions through wireless headsets.|Guests with limited vision requested more information about visual stage action.|Reserve a headset when purchasing a ticket.|Headsets are available only for performances marked on the program.|A staff member will demonstrate the controls before the performance.|The service is not available at every performance.

Supplier delivery windows|採購物流|local suppliers|The distribution center will accept deliveries only during assigned time windows.|Unscheduled trucks have caused congestion at the loading area.|Confirm the assigned arrival window with the transport coordinator.|Drivers who arrive early must wait in the designated holding area.|The coordinator will revise the schedule if a delivery is canceled.|Arriving early does not guarantee earlier unloading.

Mentor matching|職場人事|new employees|New employees may join a mentoring program outside their own departments.|The company wants staff to understand work beyond their immediate roles.|List two skills to develop on the application form.|Participation is voluntary and does not affect performance evaluations.|The program office will suggest a suitable mentor after reviewing each form.|The program encourages learning across departmental boundaries.

Digital receipts|財務商務|shop customers|Customers can request an electronic receipt instead of a printed one.|Many customers said they lose paper receipts before claiming expenses.|Check the email address displayed before confirming the purchase.|A paper copy remains available on request.|The system will send the receipt immediately after payment is accepted.|Customers still have a choice of receipt format.

Bike maintenance clinic|交通運輸|bicycle commuters|A mechanic will provide basic bicycle checks in the office courtyard.|A staff survey identified brake problems as a common commuting concern.|Book a short inspection slot on the staff calendar.|Replacement parts are charged separately even though the inspection is free.|The mechanic will provide a written estimate before fitting any part.|A free check does not mean that all repairs are free.

Food allergy labels|餐飲零售|canteen staff|The canteen will display ingredient lists beside all prepared meals.|Customers need clearer information to avoid ingredients they cannot eat.|Verify the ingredient list whenever a recipe changes.|A meal must not be labeled safe for every allergy.|The catering supervisor will compare the displayed lists with kitchen recipes.|Accurate labels require updating when ingredients change.

Remote equipment loans|科技維修|remote employees|Portable monitors are available for employees working away from the office.|Staff reported difficulty comparing documents on a single small screen.|Submit a loan request with the expected return date.|Equipment may not be transferred to another employee without approval.|The technology team will send collection instructions once a request is approved.|The loan is linked to a particular employee rather than a whole team.

Historic trail signs|文化休閒|walking tour guides|New signs will be installed along the historic riverside trail.|Several intersections have confused visitors who follow the printed map.|Report any location where a sign would improve navigation.|Signs cannot be fixed directly to protected stone walls.|The heritage committee will approve locations before installation.|Conservation rules influence where signs can be placed.

Invoice reference numbers|財務商務|contractors|Every invoice must show the purchase order reference supplied by the company.|Payments have been delayed when accounting staff could not identify the related order.|Add the reference to the invoice before sending it.|An invoice without a reference will be returned for correction.|The accounting team will process corrected invoices in the next payment cycle.|Missing information can delay payment even when the work is complete.

Community rehearsal rooms|活動企劃|local musicians|Rehearsal rooms will be available for community groups on weekday evenings.|The center has unused rooms after its daytime classes finish.|Submit a description of the group and its usual instruments.|Amplified music must remain below the posted sound limit.|The center will review trial bookings before adding more evening hours.|Access may expand if the initial arrangement works well.

Cold storage training|製造品質|food warehouse workers|All workers entering cold storage must complete a brief safety session.|Recent inspections found inconsistent use of protective clothing.|Choose a training session before requesting a new access card.|Current access cards will continue to work until the training deadline.|Supervisors will verify attendance before authorizing replacement cards.|Workers have a transition period before the new requirement applies fully.

Parking space sharing|交通運輸|office drivers|Employees can release unused parking reservations to a shared daily pool.|Reserved spaces were often empty while visiting colleagues could not park.|Cancel a space reservation on days when working elsewhere.|Released spaces are assigned in the order requests are received.|The reception team will notify drivers when a space becomes available.|A space can benefit another driver if its owner releases it.

Reusable event badges|活動企劃|conference organizers|Badge holders will be collected at the exit for reuse at future events.|Most holders remained undamaged after the last conference.|Place collection boxes beside each exit door.|Printed name inserts must be removed before holders are reused.|Volunteers will count the returned holders after the venue closes.|Personal information should not remain in reused badge holders.

Independent stock checks|採購物流|store supervisors|A staff member from another branch will verify each monthly stock count.|Independent checks can reveal errors that a familiar team overlooks.|Arrange a visit with the assigned partner branch.|The visiting employee must not change figures without discussing discrepancies.|The inventory manager will investigate unresolved differences.|The second check is meant to verify the count rather than replace discussion.

Customer research interviews|行銷服務|regular customers|The design team is inviting customers to discuss their experience with the ordering page.|Sales records show where orders stop but do not explain the reasons.|Choose an interview time using the invitation link.|Participants may decline to answer any question.|The team will combine findings without naming individual customers.|The interviews seek explanations that numerical records cannot provide.

Library sewing machines|教育學習|library members|Members may borrow sewing machines after attending a demonstration.|The library is expanding its collection beyond books and digital media.|Bring a membership card to the demonstration.|Borrowers must supply their own fabric and thread.|Staff will inspect each machine when it is returned.|The service lends equipment but not all necessary materials.

Battery collection bins|環境設施|building occupants|Used household batteries can be left in marked collection bins near reception.|Batteries should not be mixed with ordinary office waste.|Cover exposed terminals before placing batteries in a bin.|Damaged or leaking batteries must be handed directly to facilities staff.|A specialist contractor will collect the bins when they are full.|Some batteries require separate handling rather than routine disposal.

Flexible workshop tickets|教育學習|course participants|Workshop tickets can be transferred to another participant before the session begins.|People who become unavailable may still know someone who can use the place.|Email the replacement participant's name to the course office.|The original ticket cannot be used after the transfer is confirmed.|The office will issue a new confirmation to the replacement participant.|A transferred ticket does not create a second available seat.

Water meter inspection|房產營建|apartment residents|A contractor will inspect water meters in each apartment over the coming week.|Unexpected usage figures suggest that several meters may need adjustment.|Choose an access appointment from the posted schedule.|The contractor will show identification before entering an apartment.|Residents will receive a report if their meter requires replacement.|An inspection does not necessarily mean that a meter will be replaced.

Customer pickup shelf|餐飲零售|bakery customers|Prepaid bread orders will be placed on a labeled collection shelf.|The bakery wants to shorten queues during the morning rush.|Check the order number before taking a bag.|Orders containing chilled items must still be collected from a staff member.|The bakery will review the arrangement after customers have tried it.|Not every prepaid order can be collected without staff assistance.

Proposal feedback sessions|職場人事|project applicants|Short feedback meetings will be offered to teams whose proposals were not selected.|The review panel wants useful ideas to be improved for the next funding round.|Send specific questions before the meeting.|A feedback meeting will not reopen the original funding decision.|Panel members will explain the main evaluation criteria.|The meetings support future applications rather than immediate appeals.

Emergency contact updates|職場人事|all staff|Employees are being asked to review the emergency contact details in their profiles.|Several contact numbers failed during a recent drill.|Confirm the current number with the person listed as your contact.|Do not enter a colleague's number without that person's agreement.|The personnel team will send reminders to staff with incomplete profiles.|Contact information should be verified rather than copied without checking.

Recycled paper trial|環境設施|print room users|The print room will test recycled paper for internal documents.|The purchasing team is comparing environmental benefits with printing performance.|Report any paper jams or unclear printouts during the trial.|Legal originals must continue to use the approved archival paper.|The purchasing team will decide whether to extend the trial to other offices.|The trial does not apply to every type of document.

Mobile payment backup|財務商務|market vendors|Vendors will receive printed instructions for accepting payments when the mobile network is unavailable.|A recent outage prevented customers from completing several purchases.|Keep the backup instructions at the sales counter.|Do not write down full payment card details.|The market office will conduct a demonstration before the next market day.|The backup process must still protect payment information.

Bird observation walks|文化休閒|nature reserve visitors|Early morning observation walks will be limited to small groups.|Large groups can disturb nesting birds near the main trail.|Register with the visitor center before joining a walk.|Participants must remain on the marked path even when birds move away.|Guides will adjust the route if nesting activity changes.|Wildlife needs can affect the route chosen for a walk.

Shared translation glossary|辦公協作|international sales staff|A shared glossary will standardize the terms used in overseas product descriptions.|Different translations of the same feature have confused customers.|Suggest missing terms through the glossary feedback form.|New entries must be reviewed before they appear in published materials.|A language specialist will review suggestions each week.|Employees can propose terminology but cannot publish it without review.

Reusable packing demonstration|採購物流|shipping assistants|A demonstration will show staff how to secure products in reusable packaging.|The new packaging requires a different arrangement of protective inserts.|Bring one example of a product that is difficult to pack.|Do not send trial packages to customers until they have passed a handling test.|The packing team will update its illustrated instructions after the demonstration.|The packaging method needs testing before normal customer use.

Locker waiting list|環境設施|fitness center members|Members may join a waiting list for long-term locker rental.|All large lockers are currently occupied.|Provide a telephone number that staff can use during opening hours.|An offered locker must be accepted within two days.|Unaccepted offers will be passed to the next person on the list.|Being on the waiting list does not reserve a locker indefinitely.

Exhibition loan forms|文化休閒|local artists|Artwork loan forms must now include a condition photograph.|Photographs help staff identify any change while an item is on display.|Attach a clear image taken immediately before delivery.|The image must show the entire work rather than only a signature.|The curator will compare the image with the artwork on arrival.|The photograph serves as a record of condition rather than advertising.

Accessible application forms|科技維修|website editors|Online application forms will be checked for compatibility with screen readers.|Some applicants have been unable to identify unlabeled form controls.|Add a clear text label to every required field.|Placeholder text alone is not an acceptable field label.|The accessibility team will test revised forms before publication.|Visual appearance alone does not establish that a form is accessible.

Seasonal menu tasting|餐飲零售|restaurant employees|Staff will taste the seasonal menu before it is introduced to customers.|Servers need to describe unfamiliar dishes accurately.|Note the main ingredients and preparation methods during the tasting.|Employees with food allergies should review the ingredient list before sampling.|The chef will answer questions after each dish is presented.|The tasting is part of staff preparation rather than a public promotion.

Shared project archive|辦公協作|project leaders|Completed project files will be stored in a central archive.|Teams have spent too much time searching separate personal folders.|Upload the final approved documents with a short project summary.|Draft files must be clearly separated from approved versions.|The records officer will check the archive for missing documents.|The archive is intended to make authoritative versions easier to find.

Bus stop relocation|交通運輸|commuters|The bus stop outside the health center will move temporarily to the next block.|Construction equipment needs access to the pavement beside the original stop.|Follow the temporary direction signs from the old stop.|Buses will keep their current departure schedule.|The transport office will announce when the original stop can reopen.|Passengers must change where they wait but not the scheduled departure time.

Rental tool orientation|製造品質|equipment renters|First-time users of powered cutting tools must complete an orientation.|The rental company has introduced an additional safety check.|Arrive early enough to attend the demonstration before collection.|A previous rental of hand tools does not satisfy this requirement.|Staff will record completion so that repeat users need not attend again.|The requirement depends on the type of tool previously used.

Conference dietary requests|活動企劃|conference delegates|Dietary requirements must be submitted through the registration page.|The catering team needs confirmed quantities before ordering ingredients.|Update the dietary field even if a request was mentioned in an earlier email.|Changes submitted after the deadline cannot be guaranteed.|The event office will send a summary of each delegate's meal request.|An informal email may not be included in the final catering count.

Peer editing circle|教育學習|adult writing students|Students may join a peer editing circle between regular classes.|Several learners asked for more opportunities to receive feedback.|Bring a short draft and identify the type of feedback you need.|Members should discuss the writing rather than judge the writer.|The instructor will provide a checklist for constructive comments.|The activity depends on respectful feedback from other learners.

Supplier packaging survey|採購物流|purchasing managers|The company will compare the packaging waste produced by its suppliers.|A lower purchase price may be offset by higher disposal costs.|Record the weight and type of packaging in each sample delivery.|Do not include the weight of the products themselves.|The sustainability team will combine the measurements into a supplier report.|The comparison includes costs beyond the price of the product.

Flexible rehearsal schedule|活動企劃|community performers|Rehearsal groups can exchange time slots if both leaders agree.|Changes in work schedules have made some original bookings difficult to use.|Send a joint confirmation of the proposed exchange.|The total hours assigned to each group cannot increase through an exchange.|The center will update its calendar only after receiving both confirmations.|An exchange changes timing rather than the amount of booked time.

Password manager training|科技維修|office employees|Staff will be offered training in the approved password manager.|Reusing passwords across services creates avoidable security risks.|Bring the company device you use for daily work.|Employees must not share their master password with the trainer.|The support team will provide a written setup guide after the session.|Training should not require disclosure of a private master password.

Garden waste collection|環境設施|neighborhood residents|Garden waste will be collected separately from household rubbish.|The council plans to turn suitable plant material into compost.|Place leaves and small branches in the marked reusable container.|Soil, stones, and plastic bags must not be placed in the container.|Collection crews will leave a notice if unsuitable material is found.|Separating materials helps keep the composting process usable.

Visitor parking validation|行銷服務|office visitors|Visitors can have parking validated at the reception desk.|The building has replaced its paper parking vouchers with a digital record.|Give the receptionist the vehicle registration number before leaving.|Validation applies only to the time spent on company business.|The parking system will apply the approved period when the driver exits.|A visitor may still pay for parking unrelated to the visit.

Instrument calibration labels|製造品質|production supervisors|Measuring devices will display a label showing the next calibration date.|Staff need a quick way to check whether a device is suitable for inspection work.|Check the label before using a measuring instrument.|A device past its calibration date must be removed from service.|The quality team will arrange a replacement while calibration is completed.|A device can be unavailable even if it appears to function normally.

Reading group language choice|教育學習|book club members|Members may choose between an original edition and an approved translation for the next discussion.|The group wants readers with different language backgrounds to participate.|Tell the coordinator which edition you plan to read.|Discussion questions will refer to chapter titles rather than page numbers.|The coordinator will circulate matching chapter lists.|Page numbers may differ between the available editions.

Noise measurement visits|房產營建|apartment occupants|An engineer will measure sound levels in selected apartments.|Residents have reported noise from the new ventilation equipment.|Allow access during the appointment period if your apartment is selected.|Keep windows closed during the measurement so results can be compared.|The engineer will recommend adjustments after reviewing the readings.|Consistent conditions are needed to compare the measurements fairly.

Product photo guidelines|行銷服務|online sellers|Product listings must include a photograph against a plain background.|Busy backgrounds can make product details difficult to see on small screens.|Upload at least one clear image of the actual item.|Images of a similar model cannot replace images of the item being sold.|The review team will return listings that do not meet the image requirements.|An attractive image is insufficient if it shows the wrong product.

Donated furniture inspection|社區服務|donation volunteers|Donated furniture will be checked before being placed in the community shop.|The organization wants to avoid offering items that are unsafe or unusable.|Record visible damage when accepting a donation.|Items with exposed wiring must be assessed by a qualified technician.|Approved furniture will receive a dated inspection label.|Not all donated items can be offered for sale immediately.

Flexible collection authorization|行銷服務|parcel recipients|Customers can authorize another person to collect a parcel.|Some recipients cannot visit the depot during its opening hours.|Complete the authorization section in the collection notice.|The collector must bring identification matching the authorized name.|Depot staff will record the collection before releasing the parcel.|Possession of the notice alone is not enough to collect for someone else.

Library oral history project|文化休閒|long-term residents|The library is recording local residents' memories for an oral history collection.|Written records do not capture every aspect of everyday life in the town.|Contact the project librarian to arrange an interview.|Participants may restrict public access to parts of their recording.|The librarian will provide a consent form before recording begins.|Participation does not require unrestricted public release of every memory.

Guest wireless network|科技維修|meeting hosts|Hosts must request a separate wireless access code for visiting groups.|Guest devices should not connect to the internal company network.|Include the visit date and expected number of devices in the request.|Access codes expire at the end of the approved visit.|The technology team will send the code to the host before the meeting.|A code from a previous visit may no longer work.

Catering container returns|餐飲零售|event coordinators|Catering trays will be collected after events rather than discarded.|The supplier has introduced durable containers that can be cleaned and reused.|Place empty trays together in the agreed collection area.|Do not put reusable trays in the venue's recycling bins.|The supplier will count the trays when collecting them.|Containers intended for reuse need a different return process from ordinary waste.

Public workshop waiting area|教育學習|workshop visitors|A waiting area will be provided for adults accompanying younger participants.|The teaching room does not have enough space for extra observers.|Wait in the lounge until the instructor announces the end of the session.|Only registered participants may use the workshop tools.|Staff will escort the group to the lounge when the session finishes.|Accompanying an attendee does not grant access to the tools.
